images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production parallax background PNG for Re:Trap, a 2D pixel-art platformer about reclaiming a fallen medieval castle. Landscape canvas 1536x1024. Strict coarse pixel art, visible square pixel clusters approximately 4x4 pixels, limited palette, hard stair-step silhouettes, flat color bands. No antialiasing, blur, photographic texture, text, logos, characters, creatures, traps, collectible-like bright objects. Horizontally seamless repeat: identical heights, colors and continuous shapes at left and right boundaries. Side-view game scenery, not a perspective floor. FAR layer, fully opaque. Warm subdued daytime/sunset sky, muted ivory and dusty ochre cloud bands, distant medieval castle ramparts and gently rolling hills in hazy low-contrast desaturated olive and warm stone silhouettes. Sky occupies upper 60 percent, distant castle and hills below. Restrained brass light, no sun disc. Low contrast and saturation so golden ivory foreground stone tiles remain readable. Broad quiet shapes, sparse detail.
images.postprocessing: 4x4 nearest point sampling; RGB saturation reduction (Verification 0.72, Play 0.85); Verification far contrast 0.72 around 140; RGB channels quantized to multiples of 12; near alpha threshold 192, visible vertical bounds (top and bottom) fitted into rows 564..1023; 128px edge transition to paired edge colors, quantized with binary alpha; transparent RGB zeroed.

repair_history.method: Verification far: replace old edge strips with an interior donor over a 512px periodic patch, cosine feather outer 128px per side, smooth column exposure on 4px grid. Play near: replace contaminated branch and bright gray edge colors with opaque dark slate blue. Preserve silhouettes, binary alpha and zero transparent RGB.
limitations: Literal 1px neighbor median is zero due to 4px blocks; 384 changes exceed literal zero threshold. Meaningful 4px boundary criterion passes.
Band prominence threshold explicitly chosen as 2/255; widths 40..1336 in 4px steps, circular positions, each side 100px. Larger widths cannot have disjoint 100px side windows.
No game-engine scrolling test. Donor cloud/hill shapes repeat and feathered patch changes local edge details.
Original process.ps1 predates repair; rerun fix_seams.py after it to restore repaired images.
